subject: Winthrop Street Milling and Paving Schedule
overview: Eversource and city officials presented two scheduling options for milling work on Winthrop Street, weighing the traffic impacts of daytime construction against the noise impacts of nighttime work.

items.title: Eversource Project Presentation
items.summary: Eversource presented plans to mill a 0.6-mile stretch of Winthrop Street, offering a choice between an 11-day daytime schedule with significant traffic detours or a 5-day nighttime schedule with less traffic impact.

items.title: Public Discussion and Resident Feedback
items.summary: Residents in attendance expressed a preference for nighttime work to minimize the duration of the project, while city officials noted a current preference for daytime work to avoid noise disturbances for abutters.

items.title: Timeline and Final Decision Process
items.summary: Officials stated that a final decision on the schedule would be made within a week to accommodate contractor planning, with all paving work targeted for completion by July.
